title: Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards Members on Ridgeline Pro Credit — Goodwill for Slowly Resolved Invoice Disputes
content:
When an approved invoice dispute on a Ridgeline Pro Credit account took longer to resolve than the tier's dispute resolution maximum, the dispute settlement credit includes a slow-resolution goodwill whose rate is set by the business's Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards membership.

## Days of slow resolution

The days of slow resolution are the days on the dispute's resolution clock beyond the tier's dispute resolution maximum, never below zero. The maximum is that of the account's tier:

| Tier | Dispute resolution maximum (days) |
|---|---|
| Ridgeline Pro Revolving Charge | 45 |
| Ridgeline Pro Revolving Charge Plus | 45 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 30 | 30 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 30 Select | 30 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 45 | 30 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 60 Enterprise | 30 |

## Goodwill rate

| Days of slow resolution | The business's active Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards membership | Goodwill rate |
|---|---|---|
| Above zero | ProBuild Gold, ProBuild Platinum or ProBuild Platinum Elite | 0.10 percent of the disputed amount per day |
| Above zero | ProBuild Silver | 0.05 percent of the disputed amount per day |
| Any other case — no slow days, a ProBuild Member or Bronze membership, or no active membership | | Zero |

The membership read is the business's Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards membership in active status, by its tier name.

## Amount

The slow-resolution goodwill is the disputed amount times the goodwill rate times the days of slow resolution, divided by one hundred. It enters the dispute settlement credit unrounded; the credit is rounded to the nearest cent on its total.

## Worked cases (hypothetical, Commercial Account Net 30, disputed amount 1200.00)

| Resolution clock | Slow days | Membership | Goodwill |
|---|---|---|---|
| 38 days | 8 | ProBuild Gold, active | 1200.00 times 0.10 times 8, divided by one hundred: 9.60 |
| 38 days | 8 | ProBuild Silver, active | 4.80 |
| 38 days | 8 | ProBuild Bronze, active | 0.00 |
| 30 days | 0 | ProBuild Platinum, active | 0.00 |
